mapper.select: SELECT P.PLACE_NO , P.PLACE_NAME , P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION , P.ADDR , P.ADDR_DETAIL , P.PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE , T.TYPE , TD.TYPE_DETAIL , P.X_AXIS , P.Y_AXIS FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT IMG_ORDER , IMG_PATH || SAVE_NAME AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE_IMG WHERE PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY IMG_ORDER , IMG_NO

SELECT P.PLACE_NO , P.PLACE_NAME , P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION , P.ADDR , P.X_AXIS , P.Y_AXIS , ( SELECT MAX(PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PI.IMG_ORDER, PI.IMG_NO) FROM PLACE_IMG PI WHERE PI.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PI.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P WHERE P.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo}

SELECT P.PLACE_NO , P.PLACE_NAME , P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION , P.ADDR , P.X_AXIS , P.Y_AXIS , ( SELECT MAX(PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PI.IMG_ORDER, PI.IMG_NO) FROM PLACE_IMG PI WHERE PI.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PI.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS IMAGE_URL FROM TYPE_DETAIL T LEFT JOIN PLACE P ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = T.TYPE_DETAIL_NO WHERE T.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = #{typeDetailNo}

SELECT P.PLACE_NO, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.ADDR_DETAIL, P.PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE, T.TYPE, TD.TYPE_DETAIL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, ( SELECT MAX(PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PI.IMG_ORDER, PI.IMG_NO) FROM PLACE_IMG PI WHERE PI.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PI.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO

SELECT DISTINCT P.PLACE_NO, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.ADDR_DETAIL, P.PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE, T.TYPE, TD.TYPE_DETAIL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, ( SELECT MAX(PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PI.IMG_ORDER, PI.IMG_NO) FROM PLACE_IMG PI WHERE PI.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PI.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (T.TYPE = #{type} OR TD.TYPE_DETAIL = #{type}) ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO

SELECT P.PLACE_NO, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.ADDR_DETAIL, P.PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE, T.TYPE, TD.TYPE_DETAIL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, ( SELECT MAX(PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PI.IMG_ORDER, PI.IMG_NO) FROM PLACE_IMG PI WHERE PI.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PI.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLACE_TAG PT JOIN TAG TG ON PT.TAG_NO = TG.TAG_NO WHERE PT.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND TG.TAG_CONTENT = #{tag} ) ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO
